documents.title: Relocation housing
documents.text: You compared apartment deposits before relocating. You asked how landlords assess rental applications and whether references would help. No signed rental contract was documented.

documents.title: Engineering interview preparation
documents.text: You practiced engineering interviews and discussed distributed systems tradeoffs. You asked for feedback on explaining failure recovery. No job offer or interview outcome was documented.

documents.title: Running Saariv locally
documents.text: You requested running Saariv directly on your machine without Docker. You asked to open the application in the in-app browser. These requests do not establish that you deployed the application to production.

documents.title: Story extraction format
documents.text: You requested domain, subdomain, topic, and subtopic labels from the first prompt. You requested a narrative story from the second prompt, including only your own messages and excluding assistant responses.

documents.title: Portable knowledge retrieval
documents.text: You chose a local prototype with an embedding API. You wanted different models and agents to access the same saved knowledge. You asked how to measure retrieval quality, latency, and cost.
